## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and any relevant manual verification.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to one concern.
- [ ] Relevant tests or checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or configuration changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private models, generated build output, or `.env` files are included.
- [ ] I agree to contribute this change under AGPL-3.0-or-later.
